description.en: A small macOS menu bar app that keeps your files in sync with Google Drive.
description.zh: 轻巧的 macOS 菜单栏工具，把文件和文件夹同步到 Google Drive。

source.description: macOS menu bar utility that syncs files and folders to Google Drive via rsync

subject.en: Original grey faceted shrike with a dark eye mask
subject.zh: 保留原图的灰色碎片化伯劳与深色眼罩

description.en: The original head, hooked beak, eye mask, shoulders, and canvas are preserved exactly. The existing compact silhouette stays the source of every foreground size.
description.zh: 头部、钩状鸟喙、眼罩、肩羽和画布全部原样保留，现有紧凑轮廓是所有透明尺寸的唯一来源。

description.en: The silver crown, charcoal eye band, blue-grey beak, and warm shoulder facets are untouched. No new ornament or image-generation call is needed for this retained identity.
description.zh: 银灰头顶、炭黑眼带、蓝灰鸟喙与暖色肩羽均未修改。这次沿用既有形象，不增加装饰或调用生图。

description.en: Oversized angular pleats enter a slate field from opposite corners. Narrow edge highlights and a low shadow give the grey bird separation without adding a scene.
description.zh: 大幅折翼纹从对角进入石板色底面，细边高光和轻浅阴影让灰色主体清晰浮现，保持图标简洁。

sizeNote.en: The beak and dark eye band carry the mark at small sizes. Menu bar template icons keep their existing monochrome silhouette; app, toolbar, and browser derivatives retain their distinct roles.
sizeNote.zh: 小尺寸由鸟喙与深色眼带承担识别。菜单栏模板图保留现有单色轮廓；应用、工具栏与浏览器图标分别按各自用途处理。
